work: The Four Principles Underlying The Dress Of Mourning
heading: Liji 46 · Sang Fu Si Zhi 喪服四制 · The Four Principles Underlying The Dress Of Mourning · Sang Fu Si Zhi 11

items.text: Observe the mourning rites for a parent as prescribed: through the three years, culminating in the auspicious sacrifice.
items.quote: At the mourning rites for a parent... when the three years were completed, he offered the auspicious sacrifice.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration and sacrifices to the dead are not commanded for Christians; worship belongs to God alone.

work: The Four Principles Underlying The Dress Of Mourning
heading: Liji 46 · Sang Fu Si Zhi 喪服四制 · The Four Principles Underlying The Dress Of Mourning · Sang Fu Si Zhi 1 … Sang Fu Si Zhi 10

items.text: Wear sackcloth with jagged edges for three years for your departed father, because your love is deep.
items.quote: sackcloth with jagged edges is worn for the father for three years

items.text: While your father is alive, wear sackcloth with even edges for your departed mother for one year, because there cannot be two equal heads in the household.
items.quote: while the father is alive, the sackcloth with even edges is worn (for a mother), (and only) for a year

items.text: During the three years' mourning for your father, do not speak; only indicate that you hear what is said.
items.quote: when wearing the sackcloth with jagged edges (for a father), (a son) indicated that he heard what was said to him, but did not reply in words
